tim_relation.editorial_reading: Port Monkey's archive now has both fragmentation and repair trajectories. Late-2024 Tree conflict remains important, but a 4 March 2026 conversation-recovered scene adds seed-growth language, contact with GG around a proposed grievance/healing meeting, and a later Potato-tree/Heaven stewardship story. These later records are not proof of completed reconciliation.
tim_relation.source_boundary: Roles and traits are archival descriptions of how the figure appears in old sources. Motive, diagnosis, criminality, and permanent moral essence are not inferred from the old profile prose.

meaning.why_this_file_matters: Port Monkey is one of the best change-over-time files: the same archive contains ordinary companionship, Tree/community fragmentation, later conflict clustering, and a 2026 seed/stewardship/repair possibility.
known: Port Monkey appears in ordinary November 2024 gaming/voice-chat scenes.
Chronicle places Monkey/Tree material inside the December 2024 community-fragmentation corridor.
4 March 2026 recovery adds seed-growth language and a report of a proposed grievance/healing meeting.
interpretive: Trickster/mirror/threshold roles describe different phases, not a timeless essence.
The 2026 seed/stewardship material can be read as a repair trajectory, but completed reconciliation is not established.
unknown: Identity continuity between every 'Monkey' and 'Port Monkey' occurrence requires scene-level checking.
Whether the reported grievance/healing meeting happened and changed anything remains open.
